findings.rationale: Correct: §1 overclaims. Folded: §1 lists residual routes per write class (config key, ref, working-tree file, commit) with the layer that covers each; working-tree writes by absolute path are detected by an outer real-repo `git status --porcelain` diff that WARNS (names paths), and are otherwise an accepted residual.
Accepted (git never rewrites object files in place, but the cost of removing the doubt is ~0.9 s measured). Folded: G4 uses `git clone --no-hardlinks`.

Correct. Folded: G4 names ref divergence (only the real current branch + remote-tracking heads + tags; no refs/autopilot/*, no other local branches, fresh local config) and justifies it by §0.1 (zero clone-induced reds); the snapshot checks out the real branch name with `checkout -B`.

Correct. Folded: P1 inventory enumerates every syntax: `config user.email`, `-c user.email=`, `GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=`, `GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=`, `EMAIL=`, and JS argv arrays containing user.email; any unmatched syntax found by a broad `@` scan in git-invoking tests fails the inventory with the line.

Correct. Folded: the env bypass is removed. A fixture repo opts out with its own local config key `autopilot.testIdentityGate=off`; it is never inherited through the environment, and G6 would flag it if a leak wrote it into the real repo.
Correct. Folded: pre-push checks author and committer email of `git rev-list <remote_sha>..<local_sha>` (new ref: `<local_sha> --not --remotes`), so history already on the remote is excluded.
Correct. Folded: §4 states, per phase, a RED case and a negative control.

Correct. Folded: G5 binds the snapshot to the reaper: the outer run holds flock on `$SNAP/.autopilot-live.lock` for its lifetime; the reaper treats `autopilot-test-snapshot.*` as residue only when that lock is free; inner worktree reaping runs inside $SNAP before removal.
Correct. Folded: AUTOPILOT_TEST_REAL_ROOT is dropped; the real root stays in a non-exported outer variable. KR1/R9(c) tests drive the snapshot functions against a fixture "real" repo.
Same defect as 26903abad7 (ref/config divergence), same fold.
Correct: exec forecloses the after-check. Folded: G3 runs the inner run.sh as a waited CHILD, never exec; G6/G7 run only in the outer process (skipped when AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT_ROOT is set).
Folded with 9b46a42e2a: tests call is_test_identity_email, never restate G2.

Same as fcc1aa447e (inheritable bypass); identity pinning folded: pre-commit/pre-merge-commit read `git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT`/`GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT`, which resolve env+config exactly as git writes them.
Folded with eb74d128a0. §0.1 baseline construction difference is named; P4 compares red sets by file name.
Same as 83ab0a4fb6, same fold; lock residue is named in G5.
Folded: a named test for inversion (c).
Same as 3c1be4ad0b, same fold.
Refuted: G4 rsyncs the real working tree AFTER the checkout, so unstaged modifications to tracked files are carried. Wording clarified in G4 anyway.
Same as fcc1aa447e for the bypass. `--no-verify` is a deliberate operator act, named as an accepted residual in §1; pre-push still catches a --no-verify commit unless push is also --no-verify.
Same as eb74d128a0, same fold: P3 has its own RED cases for all three hooks.
Same as 83ab0a4fb6; folded: P4 adds exit-path tests (normal, INT during inner run, TERM during construction) asserting no $SNAP, worktree or lock residue.
Same as 184d4b3bec, same fold.
